prev.title: Kīrtan 4. Asat-saṅga tyāji’ sādhu-saṅga kara bhāi

title: Śrī Śrī Upadeśāmṛta
author: by Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu in Sanskrit
subtitle: Verse Five

text: dīkṣāsti chet praṇatibhiś cha bhajantam īśam
translation: One should (1) mentally honour the devotee who chants the Holy Name of Lord Kṛṣṇa, one should (2) offer humble obeisances to the devotee who has undergone spiritual initiation (dīkṣā) and is engaged in service to the Lord, and one should (3) associate with and faithfully serve that pure devotee who is advanced in undeviated devotional service and whose heart is completely devoid of the propensity to criticise others.
*Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur’s corresponding Bengali composition:*
Always honour within the mind those who are free from bad qualities and chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa.
Always honour with obeisances great souls who are initiated and serve Kṛṣṇa.

text: śatru mitra sad asat kichhu nā vichāre
translation: Serve those who are expert in bhajan. Consider the association of such great Vaiṣṇavas, who see Kṛṣṇa within everything, and do not conceive of enemies and friends or good and bad, to be the best of all, and serve them.
